title: ETopt-guided screening identifies thermophilic beta-agarases
summary: ETopt combines sequence, structural and protein-language-model features in an ensemble XGBoost model to predict enzyme optimum temperatures. The authors report wet-lab screening that identified two novel thermophilic beta-agarases. The draft is limited to those source-identified enzyme findings; model benchmarks and other screened enzyme classes are not counted as separate discoveries. Industrial process performance and independent replication are not established.
ai_technology: ETopt multimodal model; ensemble XGBoost; ProtBERT and Prime embeddings

evidence.tested: The source highlights experimental identification of two novel thermophilic beta-agarases; detailed enzyme activity and comparator data were not available in the reviewed abstract.
evidence.unknown: Full article, exact assay results, sequences, prior enzyme overlap and independent replication were not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: ETopt integrates learned sequence and structural representations with selected features to predict optimum temperature and prioritize candidate enzymes for wet-lab validation.

source_review.scope: Publisher highlights and abstract; PubMed primary metadata and abstract.
